caterer.name: Kitchen & Service Overtime
caterer.description: Hourly surcharge if dinner/reception extends past scheduled midnight cutoff
caterer.suggested_question: What is the hourly overtime rate for kitchen and service staff if food service extends past 11:30 PM?

caterer.name: Extra Plates / Floating Guest Buffer
caterer.description: Rate charged for guest counts exceeding guaranteed minimum head count
caterer.suggested_question: How many buffer plates are prepared, and at what rate are excess plates billed on the day?

caterer.name: GST Tax Disclosure (5% vs 18%)
caterer.description: Unitemized Goods and Services Tax (5% standalone catering vs 18% bundled hotel catering)
caterer.suggested_question: Is the quoted rate inclusive of GST, and which GST rate (5% or 18%) applies to this contract?

caterer.name: Crockery, Cutlery & Breakage Deposit
caterer.description: Security deposit and deduction schedule for broken glassware/plates
caterer.suggested_question: Is chinaware/cutlery included, and what is the breakage deposit and replacement cost per piece?

caterer.name: Transport, Chafing Fuel & Ice Charges
caterer.description: Separate line items for food transport vehicles, commercial ice, and chafing dish fuel
caterer.suggested_question: Are transport of prepared food, chafing fuel, and commercial cube ice included or billed at actuals?

caterer.name: Waiter & Uniformed Staff Gratuity/Charges
caterer.description: Service charge or mandated per-server gratuity fee
caterer.suggested_question: Is service staff remuneration fully covered, or is there an additional service charge or mandatory tip?

venue.name: Generator Diesel & Power Backup
venue.description: Diesel fuel charges for DG sets billed 'at actuals' rather than included in rent
venue.suggested_question: Does the venue rental include generator power backup and diesel fuel, or is diesel billed separately at actuals?

venue.name: Corkage & Outside Liquor License Fee
venue.description: Per-bottle or flat fee for serving family-procured liquor, plus mandatory 1-day liquor permit (FL-4)
venue.typical_impact: ₹300 to ₹800 per bottle or flat ₹25,000 to ₹50,000
venue.suggested_question: What is the venue corkage charge for serving outside liquor, and do you arrange the FL-4 permit?

venue.name: Post-Event Deep Cleaning & Waste Disposal
venue.description: Sanitation fee deducted from security deposit if hall is not cleared by morning
venue.suggested_question: Is post-event deep cleaning and trash removal included in the venue rental cost?

venue.name: Outside Vendor Royalty / In-House Mandate
venue.description: Penalty fee charged for bringing non-empanelled caterers or decorators
venue.suggested_question: Is there any royalty fee or penalty for bringing our own decorator or photographer?

venue.name: Air Conditioning Hours & Overtime
venue.description: AC switched off strictly at 11:00 PM unless paid hourly overtime in advance
venue.suggested_question: Until what exact time is central air conditioning included during the evening reception?

venue.name: Valet Parking & Traffic Marshals
venue.description: Parking space hire and dedicated valet driver fees not included in hall rent
venue.suggested_question: Does the venue rent cover dedicated valet parking drivers and municipal parking space?

decorator.name: Teardown & Mandap Dismantling Fee
decorator.description: Labor charges to dismantle mandap and staging before next morning event
decorator.suggested_question: Does your quote include complete teardown and site clearance, and by what time will it be cleared?

decorator.name: Heavy Electricity & Distribution Hookup
decorator.description: Electrician labor and 3-phase cabling from main distribution box to stage lighting
decorator.suggested_question: Are the 3-phase power distribution boxes, heavy cables, and on-site electrician included?

decorator.name: Mandi Floral Price Fluctuation Buffer
decorator.description: Surplus billed if wholesale flower rates surge during wedding muhurat week
decorator.suggested_question: Is the floral decor price fixed regardless of wholesale mandi market fluctuations during the wedding week?

decorator.name: Truck Freight & Loading/Unloading
decorator.description: Tempo transportation and local union loading (mathadi) charges
decorator.suggested_question: Are tempo transportation, toll taxes, and labor loading/unloading fees fully covered in this quote?

decorator.name: 18% GST on Decor & Production
decorator.description: Quotes presented without explicit mention of 18% GST tax liability
decorator.suggested_question: Does this quote include 18% GST, and will an official tax invoice with GSTIN be issued?

photographer.name: Lead & Candid Crew Hourly Overtime
photographer.description: Hourly rate per team member if ceremonies extend past planned 8-hour shift
photographer.suggested_question: What is the overtime rate if the Sangeet or Bidaai extends past the scheduled hours?

photographer.name: Raw Footage Delivery & Storage Drive
photographer.description: Separate charge for 2TB SSD/HDD containing all unedited 4K raw video files
photographer.suggested_question: How will raw 4K footage and photos be delivered, and is the external storage drive included?

photographer.name: Drone Operator & Local Permissions
photographer.description: Drone footage quoted but municipal/police NOC or specialized pilot billed extra
photographer.suggested_question: Is the drone pilot and aerial capture included, and who handles any required local permits?

photographer.name: Canvera / Flush-Mount Album Courier & Pages
photographer.description: Extra charge for additional album spreads (>40 pages), leatherette box, and courier shipping
photographer.suggested_question: How many pages/sheets are included in the physical photo album, and does it include shipping?

photographer.name: Crew Travel, Food & Local Logistics
photographer.description: Out-of-station meals, cabs, or hotel room requirements for 4-6 crew members
photographer.suggested_question: Are crew meals, local cab transfers, and accommodation expected from the host family?
